name: Geralf Cecani
description: Geralf Cecani is an Innistrad stitcher and necromancer who builds skaab armies and is the bitter-rival brother of Gisa.

summary.text: Geralf Cecani is an Innistrad stitcher and necromancer who builds skaab armies and is the bitter-rival brother of Gisa.

bio.text: Geralf wrote to Ludevic of Ulm seeking mentorship in necromantic fabrication, and Ludevic offered to take him under his wing.
He scolded Gisa for raising their parents and told her not to contact him, yet secretly sent skaabs to free her from the prison caravan.
He repeatedly refused to come to Gisa's aid when she was bored and begged her to go anywhere else.
During the Phyrexian invasion he defended Havengul from his hidden laboratory, joined Gisa against the Phyrexians, and stitched a behemoth and sea-beast together.
On Thunder Junction he joined Oko's crew as a necromancer and medic, and he and Gisa retrieved the map to Tarnation from Thief's Folly.
Oko disbanded the crew after announcing that Vraska and Ashiok had betrayed them.

status.text: In the latest story Geralf is alive, and his crew was disbanded by Oko with a promise of a future reunion.

timeline.summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
timeline.quote: I am in need of a mentor

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she has broken out of prison.
timeline.quote: GUESS WHO JUST BROKE OUT OF PRISON!

timeline.summary: Geralf scolds Gisa for raising their parents and tells her not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: You are being incredibly irresponsible.

timeline.summary: Ludevic offers to take Geralf under his wing, sending alchemical texts.
timeline.quote: If you are amenable, I am more than happy to take you under my proverbial wing.

timeline.summary: Geralf thanks Ludevic but declares he is sick of games.
timeline.quote: I am absolutely sick of games.

timeline.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
timeline.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

timeline.summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
timeline.quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
timeline.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: Do not contact me again.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
timeline.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

timeline.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
timeline.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
timeline.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
timeline.quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

timeline.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
timeline.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

timeline.summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
timeline.quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

timeline.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
timeline.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

timeline.summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
timeline.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends his grotesque creations, including exploding winged turtles, to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.
timeline.quote: A wave of terrible creations swarmed over the walls of Havengul to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches skaabs at frantic speed in his hidden laboratory as Havengul falls, and his skaabs bring in a massive beast.
timeline.quote: a group of the skaabs he'd set to gathering raw materials entered, half-carrying and half-dragging a massive beast.

timeline.summary: Geralf's antlered behemoth steps over the city wall and tramples Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

timeline.summary: Geralf asks Gisa to give up her broken sea-beast so his skaabs can retrieve both monsters, and Gisa, after a tantrum, agrees on condition he owes her.
timeline.quote: If your creations can drag it back to your lab, I'll let it go. But you'll owe me!

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches the behemoth and sea-beast together in a city square, believing it will be his masterpiece.
timeline.quote: Grabbing the drill he would need to create seams through the beast's chitinous armor, he grinned to himself and set to work.

timeline.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

timeline.summary: The siblings burn dead Phyrexians in a bonfire and bicker over who won the game; Geralf notes the fused beast has collapsed.
timeline.quote: "Neither of us won," Gisa snapped.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
timeline.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

timeline.summary: Oko sends Gisa and Geralf to retrieve the map from Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: "Are the two of you up for a little side mission?"

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf return with the map, revealing the path to Tarnation and the vault.
timeline.quote: "I believe this is what you were after."

timeline.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

timeline.summary: The siblings camp at night and Geralf observes that Gisa's zombies are not weakening, testing his planar theory.
timeline.quote: Her wellspring of Innistrad energy had yet to run dry.

timeline.summary: Geralf wakes Gisa, who fell asleep on watch, and they set off for Thief's Folly with her zombie animals following.
timeline.quote: They rode off into the dawn, Gisa's mismatched zombie army hopping, scurrying, and slithering after them.

timeline.summary: The siblings reach Thief's Folly and find it a patchwork of tombs from many planes.
timeline.quote: The architecture of the tombs and design of the grave markers were a patchwork amalgam of dozens of planes

timeline.summary: Geralf realizes the grave sigils are an incantation just as Gisa's whistling triggers a trap, and a giant corpsipede erupts.
timeline.quote: what looked like a centipede made from hundreds of bodies fused together

timeline.summary: Stella Lee, visiting Lucy Bluff's grave, hears the siblings arguing and meets them.
timeline.quote: Stella stepped around a crypt, and found herself looking at two pale, dark-haired people in tattered clothing.

timeline.summary: The corpsipede attacks and all three flee to the necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: "Run," said the man, grabbing the woman by the arm and charging straight toward Stella.

timeline.summary: Stella gives Geralf a bottle of angel's blood and lamp oil for free, as she has friends buried in the graveyard.
timeline.quote: "Then it's on the house." Stella tossed him the bottle

timeline.summary: Geralf uses the angel's blood to stitch a construct from Gisa's griffin to fight the corpsipede.
timeline.quote: Wild laughter rose in the distance, followed by Geralf walking back into view, leading a horrifying construct behind him.

timeline.summary: Gisa hums to track the foreign magic and leads them to a sealed Innistradi crypt, which Stella opens with her whip.
timeline.quote: When it struck the padlock, the shackle popped open and the lock fell away

timeline.summary: Geralf takes the map from the sarcophagus and the group parts ways with Stella.
timeline.quote: reached inside the sarcophagus, rooting around until he came up with a map.

timeline.summary: Stella lets the siblings go, and they ride away still bickering.
timeline.quote: "I suppose there's no captures between friends."

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

timeline.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
timeline.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

timeline.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
timeline.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

relations.note: His mother, a talented necromancer.
relations.quote: Any son of Gretchen Cecani is a son of mine.

relations.note: He has made his name creating them.
relations.quote: the very creatures I have made my name creating

relations.note: Siblings who write acrimonious letters.
relations.quote: My dearest brother—

relations.note: Gisa calls Liliana Geralf's girlfriend.
relations.quote: that arrogant girlfriend of yours, Liliana

relations.note: Siblings who bicker constantly
relations.quote: Even her own brother, dear, disgusting Geralf

relations.note: Geralf researches and defends Havengul for Ludevic
relations.quote: Ludevic has given me the great honor of researching this phenomenon

relations.note: They unite against the Phyrexians
relations.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

relations.note: Geralf defends Havengul against them
relations.quote: he has elected to trust me with the defense of Havengul

relations.note: Geralf's laboratory is in Havengul
relations.quote: I am not regretting the choice to tell you my lab was too small for the both of us

relations.note: Geralf's skaabs brought the beast to his lab
relations.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

relations.note: Gisa and Geralf are necromancer siblings.
relations.quote: That's Gisa and Geralf, the necromancer siblings.

relations.note: Gisa and Geralf are siblings.
relations.quote: "The only thing I don't have patience for is you , brother," she said.

relations.note: The two siblings are at war with each other.
relations.quote: Gisa and Geralf stood on opposite sides of the room, clearly at war with one another.

relations.note: The necromancer siblings are sent together to Thief's Folly.
relations.quote: Oko studied each member of the crew before landing on the necromancer siblings.

relations.note: The Cecani siblings are brother and sister and constant rivals.
relations.quote: "Gisa," said the woman, eyes narrowed. "Cecani."

relations.note: The siblings bicker and mock each other constantly.
relations.quote: "I wouldn't need to walk if you hadn't taken my horse apart."

relations.note: Geralf stitches the construct from Gisa's griffin and bodies.
relations.quote: a broad chest formed by stitching at least four smaller bodies together.

relations.note: Gisa and Geralf are siblings who continue bickering.
relations.quote: I guess you can count me and my brother in.

pages_say.description: Gisa's partner in the tyranny of the moorlands.
A skaberen and stitcher who builds skaab armies, Gisa's rival brother; he secretly sends skaabs to free her and seeks Ludevic's mentorship.
A skaberen whose skaabs once attacked Thraben.
Gisa's brother, a stitcher who builds constructs of flesh and refuses to rescue her from boredom.
A stitcher and skaab-maker working in a laboratory in Havengul, and Gisa's brother; he is entrusted with Havengul's defense.
A necromancer on Oko's crew who serves as the team's medic, and Gisa's sibling.
A necromancer, Gisa's brother, who describes himself as a stitcher.
A necromancer who heals Umezawa and retrieves the map to Tarnation.
A necromancer and stitcher from Innistrad who writes a monograph on planar magic and retrieves the map to Tarnation with his sister.
